text:
Nina Park: Quick coordination thread for the CloudPartner marketplace + integration launch. Need owners for blog, marketplace asset pack, benchmark narrative, webinar, and lead routing. Who can take what? :wave:
Elliot Ruiz: I can own the blog + press blurb. Suggest publish 10 days before the webinar so SEO has time. Proposed webinar date Nov 14 at 16:00 UTC.
Samira Kahn: Nov 14 ok from events. We’ll need promotion windows: announcement, reminder, final push. Also request a 30s promo clip from the partner.
Ravi Menon: For benchmarks I recommend 3 short metrics: p50 latency @512 tokens, sustained throughput at 8 GPUs, and $/1k tokens on the recommended config. Keep the methods section tiny and link to the perf repo.
Jules Carter: Marketplace asset checklist: 1) 200x200 logo, 2) 250-word description, 3) 2 screenshots (console + integration flow), 4) co-brand hero 1200x628. Deadline for assets: Oct 30.
Nina Park: Lead routing plan: marketplace leads -> HubSpot form -> tag cloud_partner_marketplace -> route to regional SDR queues. SLA: contact within 24h. MQL rule: company_size>50 OR title contains "Engineer"/"PM".
Elliot Ruiz: Blog outline: intro, partner value props, quick how-to (3 steps), benchmark highlights, CTA to register. Will need partner quote + headshot. Draft by Oct 25.
Samira Kahn: Webinar run of show: 5m host intro, 20m live integration demo, 10m benchmark walkthrough, 15m partner/customer panel, 10m Q&A. Dry run Nov 11. Who will host?
Ravi Menon: I'll run the benchmark slides and short methods note. Can we lock infra for runs? Need agreed model + quantization profile. Suggest "redwood-standard" for parity.
Jules Carter: For marketplace listing, legal wants a short data residency/Privacy blurb. Partner provided a boilerplate, will share. Also need SCIM screenshot for SSO.
Nina Park: Routing webhook example to share with partner ops: ```POST https://hooks.internal/hubspot?token=REDACTED
{
  "source": "marketplace",
  "campaign": "cloudpartner-nov",
  "email": "foo@company.com",
  "job_title": "Platform Engineer",
  "region": "EMEA"
}
On receipt: tag + assignPool(region) + setLeadAge(now).```
Elliot Ruiz: UTM scheme: utm_source=cloudmarket, utm_medium=partner, utm_campaign=cloudpartner-nov. Use this across blog, emails, and partner assets.
Samira Kahn: Promo cadence proposal: announce (T-21), reminder (T-7), last call (T-1), replay email (T+1). We should also do a short LinkedIn Live co-host with partner on launch day.
Ravi Menon: Bench numbers will be ready Oct 24 if we start runs next week. I'll add a small appendix with test harness commands.
Jules Carter: I'll prepare the asset upload sheet and share link for partners to drop files by Oct 30.
Nina Park: Action items: Elliot = blog & SEO; Samira = webinar ops & promo calendar; Ravi = bench + slides; Jules = marketplace assets & legal collab. partner-ops-bot: Reminder created: "CloudPartner Launch dry run" scheduled 2024-11-11 14:00 UTC.
Nina Park: Thanks all. I'll follow up with partner and post the GDoc with deadlines. :slightly_smiling_face:
